environment: Node test runner, python3 -I via pycall, git fast-import scratch repos; no network
surface: state-write.py: branch_run(repo, branch, fmt) -> str; Fail. janitor.py: CLI --repo --days. branches.py: load_format(repo), split(fmt), parse(fmt, branch, ids=None).

cases.title: branch_run returns a stored name only for kind run, under custom and default format
cases.given: a repo with branches holding runBranch values feature/PROJ-1-run-1, sdlc/run-1, main, release/x, empty, 5, null, list, object, true, missing key, invalid JSON, [] and null
cases.when: branch_run(repo, branch, fmt) under feature/PROJ-1-{name} and sdlc/{name}, and for a missing branch
cases.then: the matching run name comes back; every other value gives the empty string; no exception
cases.expected: the matching run name comes back; every other value gives the empty string; no exception

cases.title: Property: branch_run equals a reference model written from the spec
cases.given: 1500 generated (format, stored runBranch) pairs, committed as 1500 branches; model: starts with prefix, ends with suffix, middle is run-<ascii digits>
cases.then: the stored value when the model accepts, else the empty string
cases.expected: the stored value when the model accepts, else the empty string

cases.title: Property: malformed or non-string format gives Fail or a string
cases.given: 1000 formats from arb.format (braces, git-unsafe characters, unicode whitespace, NUL, lone surrogates, non-strings)
cases.then: outcome is Fail or a string, never another exception
cases.expected: outcome is Fail or a string, never another exception

evidence.title: property malformed fmt
evidence.inline: property branch_run malformed fmt: seed=3593848531 runs=1000 violations=0

cases.title: Hostile committed config text does not raise for object-shaped or broken JSON
cases.given: committed config text: empty, truncated, BOM, concatenated objects, NaN, 100000 open brackets, deep nesting, duplicate keys, lone surrogate
cases.actual: all returned the empty string; a JSON string, number or true at top level raised AttributeError (seed 1)
cases.specSource: plan note VS-2 only, not a spec source

cases.title: janitor.py calls branches.load_format(repo) and holds no sdlc/ branch literal outside prose
cases.then: load_format call present; no literal sdlc/ outside the docstring and .sdlc paths
cases.expected: load_format call present; no literal sdlc/ outside the docstring and .sdlc paths

cases.title: janitor with 17 malformed branchFormat values deletes no branch
cases.given: ledger S-001 done; branches sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0, feature/PROJ-1-S-001-v0-http-api-0, sdlc/S-999-v0-cli-0
cases.when: run janitor.py with each malformed format
cases.then: no branch removed; refs unchanged; exit 0
cases.expected: no branch removed; refs unchanged; exit 0
cases.actual: all 17 deleted nothing; format errors reported as a note for the four split-detectable shapes only

evidence.title: reports
evidence.inline: malformed tilde: reported=false notes=[] (and 10 more git-unsafe shapes)

cases.title: Property: load_format over generated config shapes gives Fail or a string

seeds.title: Stored run name with a trailing newline or a non-ASCII digit parses as run
seeds.detail: branch_run returns 'feature/PROJ-1-run-1\n' and 'feature/PROJ-1-run-١' because parse uses $ and \d. A real branch name cannot hold either, so the effect is small.

seeds.title: branch_run raises AttributeError when the committed config is a JSON string, number or true
seeds.detail: state-write.py calls .get on the loaded value without a type check. The same code was on main before this slice.

seeds.title: janitor.py checks the format with split only, so git-unsafe formats give no note
seeds.detail: Eleven formats (whitespace, .., ~, :, ?, [, backslash, .lock, @{, control char, extra brace) delete nothing but report nothing. validate_format would report them.

seeds.title: A non-string branchFormat makes the janitor sweep under sdlc/{name}
seeds.detail: load_format treats a number, list, object, true or null as absent. The janitor then deletes sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 and sdlc/S-999-v0-cli-0 with no note. The same happens when config.json holds a JSON list.
